tagline: Trustworthy Computational Co-Pilots for Quantum Mechanics, Materials Science, and Biology
founder_vision: QuLab Infinite was built from first principles by an independent researcher who needed better tools for rapid, honest iteration across quantum mechanics, materials science, and biology. The goal is not to replace wet labs, but to make them dramatically more efficient by providing trustworthy computational co-pilots. The platform continues to evolve with transparent validation, rigorous testing against literature, and a commitment to clarity over hype.
mission: De-risk scientific ideas fast using multi-physics digital twins and validation gauntlets

pain_points: Need rapid iteration without expensive wet lab time
Require trustworthy computational validation before committing resources
Overwhelmed by hype-driven AI tools lacking rigorous testing

value_proposition: Avoid one bad experimental direction or identify promising optimizations
Run live material simulations in Discovery Hour sessions
Multi-physics digital twins validated against literature
Transparent validation gauntlets with clear confidence scores
Clarity over hype - honest assessment of computational predictions

services.name: Discovery Hour
services.description: One focused question per session - stress test one material, plan one synthesis route, or run one FMO spectroscopy scenario
deliverables: Concrete insights on your specific material/question
Clear recommendation for next step (Pilot engagement)
rules: Limit to one focused question per session
Always end with clear recommendation for Pilot
Zero-risk way to see gauntlet and report quality
services.positioning: Low-commitment entry point - many consider $100 well spent to avoid $20k+ failed experiment

services.name: Pilot Engagement
services.description: Full validation gauntlet on top candidate materials or synthesis routes
deliverables: Actionable recommendations for wet lab work
services.ideal_for: Teams who found value in Discovery Hour and want to de-risk their top candidates

objection_handling.price_pushback: Most teams start with our $100 Discovery Hour so they can see the quality of the gauntlet and reports with zero risk. If it delivers value, we can discuss a full pilot.
objection_handling.value_explanation: A single failed lab experiment can easily cost $20k–$100k+. Our Discovery Hour often helps teams avoid one bad direction or identify a promising optimization — many consider that $100 well spent.

sales_playbook.cold_call_opener: Hi [Name], this is Joshua from QuLab Infinite. We offer a low-commitment $100 one-hour Discovery Session where we run one of your materials live and give you concrete insights. Would you be open to booking a quick slot next week?
sales_playbook.discovery_close: Great — let's start with the $100 Discovery Hour so you can see the output quality firsthand. If it's useful, we can move to a full pilot on your top candidates.
